---
title: "xdssat: DSSAT on a grid"
subtitle: "The unmodified DSSAT engine, driven from Python over every weather cell of a region"
---

```{ojs}
import {withDownload, fmt} from "../assets/js/dl.js"
runs = FileAttachment("../java/data/runs.json").json()
summary = FileAttachment("../java/data/summary.json").json()
cur = summary.current
```

xdssat does not reimplement DSSAT. It writes the engine's own input files for each grid cell and season,
runs the stock `dscsm048` executable in parallel chunks, and collects the results into a CF netCDF file.
The [DSSAT training](../learn/index.qmd) modules use the same building blocks on single experiments.

| Module (`src/`) | Role |
|---|---|
| `config.py` | All locations: engine, work root, source data, cache (`XDSSAT_*` variables) |
| `wth.py` | Read and write daily weather files (`.WTH`) |
| `sol.py` | Read and write soil profiles (`.SOL`) |
| `filex.py` | Build one FileX per chunk from a template experiment: one treatment per cell-season, all dates shifted with planting |
| `genotype.py` | Cultivar files written into each run folder, with coefficient overrides |
| `runner.py` | Run chunks in parallel, isolate cells that crash the engine, read outputs |
| `outputs.py` | Gridded CF netCDF of a run's seasonal results |
| `agera5.py`, `rasters.py`, `soils.py`, `management.py` | Weather cache, 100 m rasters, soil profiles from SoilGrids, strata and planting calendars |

::: {.source-note}
From the repository README; the module docstrings hold the details and the measured facts.
:::

## Runs so far

Every run folder in the cache, with its size and wall time (the case study's runs):

```{ojs}
withDownload(Plot.plot({
  width: Math.min(width, 760), height: 50 + runs.length * 26, marginLeft: 300,
  x: {label: "Seasons simulated (thousands)", grid: true},
  y: {label: null},
  color: {legend: true, domain: ["current", "other"], range: ["#2a7f62", "#9bb8ad"]},
  marks: [Plot.barX(runs, {y: "run", x: d => d.seasons / 1000, fill: d => d.current ? "current" : "other", tip: true,
    channels: {minutes: "minutes", failed: "failed"}, sort: {y: "-x"}})]
}), "xdssat-runs-overview")
```

The current run simulated ${fmt.int(cur.seasons)} seasons with ${fmt.int(cur.failed)} rejected by the engine in ${fmt.d1(cur.minutes)} minutes on ${cur.workers} engine processes.
